- [SHOULD] design/tokens/tokens.json:1 (dfw-ds/type-contrast) Largest size 16px is only 1.0× body; product UIs need ≥ 1.8× for clear hierarchy.
- [SHOULD] design/tokens/tokens.json:1 (dfw-ds/type-display) No display sizes (font.size.display-*): titles and key numbers will sit at body scale, the most common "AI look".
Fix MUST items before moving on; SHOULD items unless the brief or a recorded decision says otherwise."
}
